text:
Label tubes.
Wait 20 minutes.
After the first wait ends, rinse tubes.
Wait 12 minutes.
After the second wait ends, record the label.
Incubate overnight.

# Alpha
Wait 10 minutes.
# Beta
Wait 4 minutes.
After that interval ends, label the rack.

Wait 9 minutes.
Wait 11 minutes.
During the first wait, watch the sample.

Wait 12 minutes.
Wait 7 minutes.
After one of these intervals, record the tag; which is unspecified.
